changes: Vendored under packages/webos_plugins/audioplayers_soloud to permit a pinned app dependency.
Added an atomic SoLoud post-mix callback over the final interleaved audio sent to ALSA.
Added a bounded PCM ring and a Flutter GLES texture host for MilkRust.
The app routes only known progressive MP3, WAV, OGG Vorbis, and FLAC inputs of at most 10 MiB to this backend; other inputs keep the LG NDL route.

licenses.plugin: BSD-3-Clause; retain upstream SPDX headers and copyright notices
licenses.additional_sources: The pinned LG Flutter webOS runtime OSS notice enumerates the vendored flutter_soloud, SoLoud, Xiph Ogg/Opus and other plugin dependencies. Source-level SPDX headers remain in place; the app registers the LG BSD-3-Clause, flutter_soloud MIT and SoLoud zlib/libpng notices separately.

qualification: Source only; native compile, webOS device behavior, playback compatibility, rendering fidelity, and binary distribution review are unqualified.
